City of Molena, Pike County, Georgia

Pursuant to Georgia Code 40, Section 40-6-183, and section 40-6-376 the Uniform Rules of the Road Act, for Local Authorities to alter lawful speed limits, following is an ordinance regulating speed limits within the City of Molena,

Be it ordained that the following speed zones are established.
3:
S.R. 18 from the West City Limits (m.p. 1.92) .12 miles West of Dunn Street to Point 264’ East of West Jones Street (m.p. 2.17), a distance of 0.25 miles, to be zoned for 45 M.P.H.

S.R. 18 from a point 264’ East of West Jones Street (m.p. 2.17) to Hill Street (m.p. 2.44), a distance of 0.27 miles to be zoned for 40 M.P.H.

S.R. 18 from Hill Street (m.p. 2.44) to Daniel Road (m.p. 2.90), a distance of 0.46 miles to be zoned for 35 M.P.H.

S.R. 18 from Daniel Road (m.p. 2.90) to a point 1320’ East of Daniel Road (m.p. 3.15), a distance of 0.25 miles to be zoned for 40 M.P.H.

S.R. 18 from a point 1320’ East of Daniel Road (m.p. 3.15) to the East City Limits (m.p. 3.42), a distance of 0.27 miles to be zoned for 45 M.P.H.

S.R. 109 from S.R. 18 (m.p. 2.63) to point 950’ East of Watts Street (m.p. 2.88), a distance of 0.25 miles to be zoned for 35 M.P.H.

S.R. 109 from a point 950’ East of Watts Street (mp. 2.88) to the East City Limits (m.p.

3.24), a distance of 0.36 miles to be zoned for 45 M.P.H.
